description.en: The ID of the region where the session resides.

descriptions.zh:
- 关闭指定Session数据连接，Session不可再使用。

- Session关联的WebSocket URL也会失效，不可再使用。
descriptions.en:
- Closes the data connection of a specified session. The session can no longer be used.

- The WebSocket URL associated with the session also becomes invalid and can no longer be used.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs end-terminal-session --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --session-id s-hz023od0x90000 --region cn-hangzhou
